extDesc.message: Hides phishing and dust scam-token rows in token-transfer tables on Etherscan-family explorers. Runs locally.
extDesc.description: Extension description (single-purpose, CWS listing summary; keep <= 132 chars).

pillHiddenCount.description: Pill text: count of rows hidden above one transfer table. $1 = number.

pillShowingCount.description: Pill text while the table's hidden rows are revealed. $1 = number.

pillShow.description: Pill toggle button: reveal hidden rows.

pillHide.description: Pill toggle button: re-hide revealed rows.

pillToggleTitle.message: Reveal lasts until the page reloads. Pagination or a table refresh hides suspicious rows again.
pillToggleTitle.description: Tooltip on the pill toggle button.

pillAskLine.message: Pro also hides dust and remembers your never-hide list.
pillAskLine.description: One-line big-clean upgrade ask shown once per session.

pillPeek.message: Pro would hide $1 more dust rows
pillPeek.description: Pill Pro-peek line (free tier, real local count). $1 = number.

pillReasonTooltip.description: Tooltip on a revealed row explaining why it was hidden. $1 = reason label plus matched text.

tokenBanner.message: Warning: this token matches known scam patterns ($1). ScamRows hides its transfer rows on address pages.
tokenBanner.description: Slim warning banner on token tracker pages. $1 = matched reason label.

popSubPaused.message: ScamRows is off. No rows are hidden anywhere.
popSubPaused.description: Popup hero sub-line when the master switch is off.

popSubLive.message: $1 suspicious rows hidden on this tab. Use the pill above a filtered table to reveal them.
popSubLive.description: Popup hero sub-line when rows are hidden on the current tab. $1 = number.

popNudgeDust.message: Pro hides zero-value and dust transfers automatically on every visit.
popNudgeDust.description: Popup nudge copy retargeted to the dust Pro row.

popNudgeBlocklist.message: Pro hides any contract you paste into your own blocklist.
popNudgeBlocklist.description: Popup nudge copy retargeted to the custom-blocklist Pro row.

popNudgeNeverhide.message: Pro remembers the tokens you never want hidden, on every explorer.
popNudgeNeverhide.description: Popup nudge copy retargeted to the never-hide Pro row.

popNudgeStats.message: Pro keeps a lifetime count of every row ScamRows has hidden.
popNudgeStats.description: Popup nudge copy retargeted to the lifetime-stats Pro row.

optDustSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Storage is unavailable.
optDustSaveFailed.description: Options dust-threshold status: storage write failure.

optBlocklistSavedCount.description: Options custom-blocklist status: entries persisted. $1 = number.

optBlocklistSkipped.description: Options custom-blocklist status suffix: rejected input lines. $1 = number.

optBlocklistTruncated.message: ; input was too long and got cut off
optBlocklistTruncated.description: Options custom-blocklist status suffix when paste exceeded the 64 KB bound.

optBlocklistSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Storage is unavailable.
optBlocklistSaveFailed.description: Options custom-blocklist status: storage write failure.

optNeverHideAdded.description: Options never-hide status: entries appended (bare address expands to all chains). $1 = number.

optNeverHideDup.description: Options never-hide status: duplicate entry rejected.

optNeverHideInvalid.message: Enter 0x followed by 40 hex characters, with an optional chain prefix such as eth:.
optNeverHideInvalid.description: Options never-hide status: malformed address rejected.

optNeverHideBadChain.message: Unknown chain prefix. Use eth, base, arb, bsc, or polygon.
optNeverHideBadChain.description: Options never-hide status: unknown chain prefix rejected.

optNeverHideCap.message: The list is full (500 entries). Remove one first.
optNeverHideCap.description: Options never-hide status: list cap reached.

optNeverHideSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Storage is unavailable.
optNeverHideSaveFailed.description: Options never-hide status: storage write failure.

optLicenseActivated.message: Pro activated. Enjoy the clean tables.

optLicenseInvalid.message: That key is not valid. Check the letters and digits and try again.
optLicenseInvalid.description: Options license status: key failed offline verification.

optLicenseStorageError.message: Storage is unavailable. The key was not saved. Try again.
optLicenseStorageError.description: Options license status: storage write failure during activation.
